scope: All48 closed recordings decoded on CPU, no outcome-based filtering; six deterministic slots per case. Original initial RGB uses saved sensors; MP4 frames are lossily recorded pixels, not claimed equal to original sensors. No extra model/encoder/simulator/replay/rendering.
frame_mapping: v40 collector records initial video index0 then action t post-state at video index t; n+1 frames. Sensor-source t0 is saved exact separately and not asserted pixel-equal to compressed video0.
frame_rule: Initial; first predicate0 true including initial, else min300,n; min(first+60,n), else min360,n; min520,n; first true->false including initial transition, else max0,n-10; final n. Native predicate order is not skill order. Repeated positions are explicit, not independent samples.
